description: Log into ArkCase and perform an audit of active complaint cases. Navigate to the Complaints module and identify all active complaints. Create a summary report file at '~/audit_report.txt'. For each complaint, list its Case Number (e.g., COM-202X-XXXX), Title, and Priority. The report should have one line per case. Credentials: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!
